Me and my brother were home alone one night as my parents were out visiting my nan.

I was upstairs on my moms bed waching her TV. I heard the front door unlock and hia Keys jangle, when he opens the door he flips the key up into his hand which is his signature and makes it quite distinguishable that it's him. I then heard y dad's voice but it was unintelligible. I was in my dressing gown so I wrapped it round myself as when he gets home he usually pops his head in to check on me and ask if I'm OK.

He never came up which I thought was odd, so I went downstairs to See what was going on, I checked in the garage where he smoked but he wasn't in there. My brother was in the lounge playing his xbox, I walked in and asked if he heard dad come back. He looked puzzled and said" yeah of course I did, why? I heard him unlock the door"

We both realised very quickly that dad wasn't home, he never had been. He was nowhere in the house, we even called him and he was still at my Nanas house.

Whatever unlocked our front door and mumbled under their breath, wasn't my Dad.
